salesCopy.problem: You know you need a knowledge management system. You've probably tried building one before. But without a clear roadmap, most people make the same costly mistakes: picking tools before understanding their needs, building systems too complex to maintain, and forgetting critical components that make everything fall apart later.

originStory.title: Why This Checklist Exists
originStory.subtitle: From years of building and coaching
originStory.story:
After years of building my own systems and coaching professionals, I kept seeing the same patterns. People would jump into tools without planning. They'd forget about backups until disaster struck. They'd set up elaborate systems but never build the habits to maintain them.

This checklist is everything I wish I had when I started; distilled into actionable steps.

methodology.title: The 8-Phase Approach
methodology.subtitle: A structured roadmap, not just a feature list

steps.title: Phase 1: Foundation and Planning
steps.description: The phase most people skip. Define your goals, understand your needs, then choose your tools.

steps.title: Phases 2-5: Build and Connect
steps.description: System architecture, capture workflows, processing routines, and connection strategies that turn scattered notes into connected knowledge.

steps.title: Phase 6: Habits and Maintenance
steps.description: The most overlooked phase. Build the routines that keep your system alive and useful.

steps.title: Phases 7-8: Optimize and Evolve
steps.description: Advanced optimization including AI integration, and continuous improvement strategies.

methodology.philosophy: A knowledge system isn't a one-time setup. It needs planning, habits, and continuous evolution.
methodology.differentiation: Most resources focus on tools and features. This checklist covers the full system lifecycle; including the phases people forget about.
